criteria.detail: With no penalty the class and the driver touch nothing: on 29 configurations (the library default and every configuration of this grid at seed 0), 51 history fields and the closing state (claim total, holdings, parked, below the floor, and where every generator got to) compared bit for bit against Network.run(); and every arm at size zero (fine once 0, fine instalments 0, fine garnish 0, cap inf, cut in 0 random, cut out 0 flow, cut in 0 flow restored, fine once 0 returned, fine garnish 0 returned) on both targets against that twin, 467 runs: 0 differ. In every run the claim total equals held plus parked at every yield, to 1e-09 of the opening stock: 7940 of 7940. Every penalised run's generators end where its twin's end, so the two draw the same numbers and their difference is the penalty's: 7800 of 7800. Where a fine is paid into the sovereign's pool it is booked as a receipt beside the bonds, and at every yield the pool equals receipts less everything passed down and the bonds outstanding equal receipts less fines: 880 of 880. The round loop's own assertions did not fire: all 7940 runs completed. Gate verdict: pass. State map: the gate identical on every configuration and the three counts above complete -> PASS; anything else -> FAIL; no gate section -> not judged, and --run does not start.
criteria.name: A54-0 the driver is the model, and its books close

criteria.detail: Fines: the first amount taken is the amount due (the share of the balance, a tenth of it, or the multiple of inflow up to the balance) and the trading accounts and the claim total both fall by exactly it; what was taken and what was not add up to what was asked; a one-off is one take, instalments are 10, and a collection either ends paid or is still taking at the last close: 3600 of 3600. 0 fines could not collect in full (an instalment the balance did not cover, written off; or a multiple of inflow still owed at the end), largest shortfall -. Caps: at no close does the target stand above its cap in a round in which it took any routed inflow: 840 of 840. 20 caps closed above the level in some round, 3000 closes in all, each with the column shut that round: claims that came without an edge (issuance, the pass-down) or the balance the target already had; largest excess 949.1. 40 caps never bit and are not read. Cuts: the target's routing edges fall by exactly the number picked, which is the share of them rounded; next round the flow on the cut edges is exactly zero and the wage bill paid is the twin's to the bit: 3360 of 3360. Only routing edges are candidates: the production target also pays wages along [75] edges that are in the adjacency and not in the routing, and no cut touches them. 0 cuts of a share that rounds to no edge did nothing and are not read. Edges put back restore the routing bit for bit: 480 of 480. State map: all three counts complete -> PASS; any short -> FAIL, and the readings below cannot be read in those cells.
criteria.name: A54-1 each penalty moves what it says and nothing else (D28)

criteria.detail: The model has four switches on this carrier (floor = which nodes are below the subsistence floor; floor spending = which of those hold less than the floor amount and spend all they have; payroll = which payers hold less than their share of the wage bill; issuance = whether the authority issues this round). Where all four sit as the twin's in every round, both runs apply the same affine map, so the effect of a fine on every node in every round, per unit taken, cannot depend on its size. Read on the one-off fines that leave the graph, each against the smallest fine on the same target: 317 cells with every switch as the twin's in both, largest gap 1.865e-13 against a tolerance of 1e-09, 0 above it. Beside them, 443 cells where a switch flipped in one of the two: 433 of those are apart by more than the tolerance, smallest gap among them 3.612e-06. State map: no stable cell above the tolerance -> PASS, the four switches are all of this carrier's non-linearity; any above -> FAIL, a channel this stage has not named, and A54-2's reading does not stand; no stable cell -> not judged.

criteria.detail: One number for all three: the target's share of the claims in the trading accounts against its twin's, less one; permanence is its mean over the last 50 rounds over its value in the first round the penalty reaches. 0 is all of it gone, 1 none of it, above 1 a gap that widened. The ratio is formed only where the first round is outside the twin's band; the state beside it says what the pair of numbers is. State map: kept = first round and tail both outside the band on the same side: the ratio is printed; near 1 none of it has gone, above 1 it has widened; gone = first round outside the band and tail inside: the ratio is printed, and it is zero to within the band; reversed = first round and tail outside the band on opposite sides: the ratio is negative, and both numbers are printed; late = first round inside the band and tail outside: the effect arrives after the first round, the ratio has no denominator and is not formed; the tail stands alone; nothing = first round and tail both inside the band: nothing here to be kept or lost, the ratio is not formed. An arm that was never applied (a cap that never bit, a cut of no edge) is this state too, and is told apart by its own columns; no band = no band: no reading.
